figures.carbon.range.method: 2005-2012: the line at the lowest and highest of the EEA's yearly allowance price and every price in that year's record: the Phase I spot exchange's daily closes (BlueNext, from 24 Jun 2005) for 2005-2007, the UK Government's auction clearing prices (DMO) for 2008-2012; the engine's merit order held as it is
figures.check.hmrc.ccl.basis: the CCL line against HMRC's electricity declarations by calendar year (Table 1b), the UK: the line is HMRC's figure
figures.check.ofgem.ro.basis: the RO line (obligation years, UK) against Ofgem's scheme value, ROCs presented x the worth of a ROC; the line adds the mutualisation payments received in 2017-18 to 2021-22
figures.check.ofgem.fit.basis: the FiT line (scheme years, GB) against the levelisation fund printed in Ofgem's annual report or annual levelisation notice for each year: the line is Ofgem's figure
figures.check.ref.direct.basis: the RO, FiT, CfD and constraint lines against REF's Table 1 totals (£bn to one decimal), REGO left out; constraints from Elexon's record 2016-2023 here, REF's database in REF's figure
figures.check.ofgem.price_cap_policy_costs.basis: £ per typical household (single-rate, 3.1 MWh a year), the RO and FiT only. Ofgem's side is its price-cap policy-cost allowance for the two schemes, a forward allowance set before each period, not money paid. The RO half uses Ofgem's own obligation level on both sides, so it tests the model's value per certificate obligated against Ofgem's forecast buy-out price; the FiT half sets the levelisation fund over Great Britain's supply against Ofgem's forecast. CfDs are left out on both sides in every year: Ofgem counted them as policy costs until v1.11 of its Annex 4 (15 May 2022), which "Removed CfD costs from the annex (moved to annex 2 - wholesale costs)". Carbon is in neither side. 2025-26 provisional on the model's side
2021-22 is the one year below 0.95 (0.94). The cause is FiT: the levelisation fund fell to £1,273.1m (2020-21: £1,603.0m), because the value of exported power to suppliers, which is taken off the fund, rose to £301.7m (£160.8m) with high wholesale prices, and generation payments fell to £1,451.9m (£1,547.0m) (Ofgem's annual levelisation notices). The model's FiT half is £4.96/MWh against Ofgem's £6.85/MWh, set beforehand from a forecast; the RO half agrees within 0.1%
figures.check.obr.levies.basis: the RO line (obligation years) and CfD (LCCC's payments, April-March) against the OBR's environmental levies outturn (public finances databank, October 2026) less the Warm Home Discount and the CRC Energy Efficiency Scheme (ONS's series), which the model does not count; the OBR's figure holds no Capacity Market, FiT or green gas levy in these years

keys.<line>.<year>.<m>: each line, each year, 2002-2024 where 1.0.0 has the year, and 2025, the provisional year, for every line (real: £ in 2024 prices (CPIH); cash: £ as paid)
keys.<line>.2025.source: where the line's 2025 figure comes from, and why it is provisional
keys.all.2025.<basis>.<m>: the 2025 total's measured, modelled and estimated parts (each line's basis); they add up
keys.<total>.<year>.<m>: the direct lines, the indirect lines, or all together, each year (2025 provisional)
keys.<line>.confidence: 1.0.0's confidence (high, medium or low); high for the direct lines, which it leaves blank
keys.carbon.<year>.basis: the carbon line's basis that year (2005-2012 estimated; 2025 modelled, provisional)
keys.carbon.<part>.<year>.<m>: carbon split: the tax collected by the Treasury, and the rest of the carbon in the price
keys.<grid>.<side>.<year>.<m>: grid (TNUoS) or balancing (BSUoS): the whole charge (raw) and the gas-led alternative's
keys.capacity_market.raw.<year>.<m>: the Capacity Market levy paid in full
keys.capacity_market.netzero_share.<year>.<en: the share of the levy net zero caused (0 to 1)
keys.capacity_market.range.<bound>.<year>.<m>: the line at the low or high share
keys.vat.rate: the VAT rate on households' bills (0 to 1)
keys.vat.domestic_share.<year>: households' share of the lines VAT is charged on (0 to 1)
keys.cfd_renewable.by_technology.<technology>: CfD by technology from the first payment to the data's end: £ cash, MWh, share of the total (all: every technology)
keys.cfd_renewable.by_technology.to: the data's end for CfD by technology (a date)
keys.cfd_renewable.reconciliation.<rec>: the contract-by-contract CfD payments against LCCC's own daily totals over the matched days: divergence and tolerance in per cent, £ cash
keys.constraint_turnup.cross_check.<cc>.cash: the turn-up estimate beside the offers accepted (all, and while wind was constrained) over the measured window, £ cash
keys.constraint_turnup.cross_check.<when>: the measured window's first and last day (dates)
keys.share_of_bill.<year>: all lines over the whole bill, 2024 prices (0 to 1)
keys.share_of_bill.headline: the same, 2002-2024
keys.per_household.headline: all lines 2002-2024, 2024 prices, over today's households
keys.per_household.<year>: all lines that year, 2024 prices, over today's households
keys.deflator.<year>.<d>: CPIH (2015 = 100), and the factor to 2024 prices
keys.bridge.<step>.<year>.<m>: the bridge with Report No. 1: each step of the walk from No. 2's money paid (no2_money_paid) to No. 1's extra cost (no1_extra_cost); the steps add up
keys.bridge.<step>.label: the step's row label in the bridge table

keys.bridge.no1.version: the Report No. 1 release the bridge reads (the gas model's version)

keys.<ranged>.range.years: the years the line has a range for, comma-separated

keys.check.ofgem.price_cap_policy_costs.schem: the schemes the price-cap check matches, comma-separated
keys.check.ofgem.price_cap_policy_costs.typic: the typical consumption both sides use, MWh a year
keys.check.obr.levies.reference_whole: the OBR's environmental levies outturn as published, the years of the check
keys.check.obr.levies.not_counted.<nc>: a scheme in the OBR's figure the model does not count, ONS's series (whd: Warm Home Discount; crc: CRC Energy Efficiency Scheme), taken off
keys.check.obr.levies.ons_parts_less_obr: ONS's series of the OBR figure's parts added up, less the OBR's figure
keys.check.obr.levies.gap.<gl>: the model's line less ONS's series of it (ro: the RO; cfd: CfDs), the gap's parts
keys.check.<check>.basis: what each side of the check holds, in words
keys.constraints.ref_years: the years of wind constraint payments still on REF's database, comma-separated: every other year is Elexon's own record (1.2.0)
